Summary: Mid-market product org (SaaS task/collab app). Completed 2-week Hosted API trial; now validating Dedicated capacity and pricing for production. Team wants predictable latency and cost for embedded chat + search features.

Hosted trial highlights (2/18-3/4):
- Trial length: 14 days. Seeded 120k user interactions (mix of dev/test + beta customers).
- Observed baseline traffic: avg 8 QPS overall, typical weekday peak 42 QPS (observed 3/01 10:34 UTC).
- Concurrency observed: sustained bursts up to 110 concurrent streams (mostly chat sessions).
- Token mix: mean input tokens 140, mean generated tokens 80, average total tokens/request ~220. Embeddings calls smaller but high volume: avg 60 tokens per request.
- Request composition: ~60% chat/generation, 30% embeddings (semantic search + vector upsert), 10% reranking/summary tasks.
- Latency: hosted p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms for chat when under trial load; embeddings p95 ~180ms. Team’s target p95 for chat <450ms (happy with hosted numbers if sustained on Dedicated).

POC / Dedicated sizing conversation (notes from 3/02 call with Alex, Priya, infra lead Martin):
- Customer wants headroom for 3x current peak for next 12 months: target peak QPS planning = 42 * 3 = ~125 QPS for chat/generation. With embeddings spikes, planning peak combined QPS target ~180-200.
- Concurrency target: plan for 250 concurrent inference streams (prefix KV cache heavy, expects many short-turn chats).
- Token profile for sizing: assume mean total tokens/request 250 for chat; embeddings 60 tokens per req. Traffic mix used for workbook: 65% chat, 30% embeddings, 5% rerank.
- Throughput requirement translated to tokens/sec: planning steady state 80 QPS * 250 tokens = 20k tokens/sec; burst capacity up to 200 QPS * 250 = 50k tokens/sec.
- Redwood Dedicated ask: recommended GPU footprint initially 4 x T4-equivalent for embeddings-heavy paths + 2 x A100-equivalent for low-latency chat (with autoscale to 6/3). Customer asked for a cost/latency tradeoff table.
- Caching & batching expectations: team will enable prefix caching for returning sessions and utilize request coalescing for embeddings upserts to reduce unit cost. They want Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching thresholds.

Security & compliance activity:
- Completed initial SOC2 questionnaire (sec team happy with answers).
- Pending items: KMS key federation (customer KMS preferred), audit log ingestion path for SIEM, retention policy confirmation for vectors.
- Legal asked for data residency confirmation (some EU customers), Redwood to confirm region routing & fallback behavior in SLA.

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Interested in a 12-month Dedicated commitment with monthly true-ups. Target ARR band $150k-$400k depending on chosen GPU family and burst bandwidth.
- Wants line-item for hosted API overage during migration window.
- Customer requested a sample contract addendum for "private tenancy" (VPC peering + dedicated control plane).
